resources.string: Android app-to-app authorization · Public client + PKCE
Set your mobile AppID (or official client ID) and your own HTTPS callback in DemoConfiguration.properties first.
Local checks do not verify platform registration. Real authorization requires a verified package, the installed app signing certificate, App Link, and an enabled service.
Choose a mode and complete the configuration to begin.
Once configured, authorize to open the Ksuser app.
Authorization mode changed. You can start a new request.
Confirm authorization in the Ksuser app or system browser.
No pending authorization request to resume.
The current authorization request was cancelled.
Official OIDC authorization succeeded. The ID token was verified.
UnionID is not enabled for this application. Identify the user by the application-specific OpenID.
This demo displays only identity and lifetime. It never displays or logs tokens.
Check the client ID, HTTPS callback, and service addresses.
A request is pending. Resume or cancel it first. A request created with an older configuration expires after five minutes.
The authorization request expired. Start a new request.
The callback did not pass validation. Check the callback address and pending transaction without weakening state validation.
The authorization response is invalid. Check compatibility between the app, SDK, and service versions.
Official identity validation failed. The identity was not accepted. Check the official client and issuer configuration.
The authorization transaction could not be stored or read securely. Check device secure storage and retry.
The network request failed. Try resuming the pending authorization.
The authorization screen could not open. Check the browser or App Link configuration, then try continuing in the browser.
The service did not complete the request. Check the HTTP status, error code, and service availability, or resume later.
Authorization is incomplete. Try resuming, or cancel and start again.
